lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

The CEO of a Canadian armoured vehicle manufacturer says that his company ‘is not going to even consider’ taking on any responsibility for the more than 2,200 people on layoff at the Brampton assembly plant, The Canadian Press reports.
Pentagon chief Pete Hegseth calls US House impeachment effort a ‘farce’, Al Jazeera reports.
British children’s author and comedian David Walliams used his fame to groom girls and young women for sex, two British news outlets reported on Tuesday.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
